author: Matt Wolfe
description:
ChatGPT can now do things for you even when you're not using it.

Dots are their new always-on AI agents that can take on ongoing tasks and work proactively in the background.

Here are 3 ways to put yours to work:
💰 Get money back: Track purchases and catch price drops so you don't get a bad deal.
✈️ Avoid travel headaches: Monitor delays, find alternative routes, and prepare backup plans.
📩 Never drop the ball: Keep track of promises, deadlines, and follow-ups across your email and calendar.

And you don't have to keep prompting it. Your dot can keep working and bring things back for your approval.

Dots are rolling out to eligible ChatGPT users, starting with Pro and Business plans.

🔗 Head to the link in the pinned comment to try these prompts for yourself!
